_meta.description: Extended life situations - demographic breakdowns, trends, and second-source confirmations. Companion to life-situations-complete.json. 3 additional data points per situation (207 total).
_meta.methodology: Each situation gets: (1) demographic breakdown (age/gender/race/income), (2) trend over time, (3) second-source confirmation. All data 2022+ unless historical trend.
